  %\VignetteIndexEntry{14. DEM source review and priority}

Current UI status: this diagnostic/review module is not mounted in the analyst
workflow. Saving/opening a Survey Event runs necessary mask checks automatically and shows
mask outputs. The implementation below is retained for internal development;
it does not require analyst review, approval or manual saving.


The unmounted module can display the saved target and observed source band unit/embedded CRS and record
assessment and prior conversion evidence, order sources and choose first- or
last-valid overlap. Save retains an immutable local review; a fresh preflight
reopens it only when the checked inputs still match. Float32 remains the intended
DEM storage. No raster processing is triggered by saving a review.

`stream_dem_preflight_server` supplies current request/result evidence to
`terrain_source_review_server`. The latter owns draft rows, modal editing, source
ordering, unsaved feedback and explicit save/reload. Pending Event edits, changed
context or a new preflight clear the old draft. A blocked/missing file hash prevents
review initialization. Source evidence is displayed without replacing it with the
analyst's interpretation.

The injected store methods `terrain_review` and `save_terrain_review` own study-local
paths and current-revision checks. `terrain_review_binding` pins the checked
snapshot. `terrain_review_write` validates rows/order, compares the expected latest
edition under an exclusive lock, writes pending JSON and renames it into place.
`terrain_review_latest` checks whether an edition matches the current snapshot.
Older editions survive resaving and input changes. The exact contract is maintained
in `dev/schemas/terrain-source-review.md`.

This app-owned annotation layer introduces no fluvgeo API. An assessment is not a
qualified coordinate operation or scientific approval. Grid issues are not cleared
by notes. The later assembly worker must rehash inputs, reconcile source evidence,
verify a current mask and preserve the recorded overlap order before publishing.

Tests in `test-terrain-source-review.R` cover persistence, reopening, priority,
evidence requirements, competing/stale saves and module interactions. Existing
preflight and Event tests cover integration and pending-input handling.
